input_unit: one target API bundle containing one API Profile, one mode-independent Helper capability set, and reviewed same-API Knowledge v3 records

source_paths.api_profile: Use an exact JSON Pointer into the supplied compact API Profile view.
source_paths.knowledge: Use /learned_hypothesis, an exact /learned_hypothesis/limitations/<index> path, or an exact item path under /exploration_guidance/historical_anchors, /variation_opportunities, or /observation_candidates.

builder_materialization.knowledge_id: The Builder attaches the exact reviewed Knowledge v3 reference.
builder_materialization.source_ref: The Builder validates source_path and attaches source_version and content_hash.
builder_materialization.local_identifiers: The Builder deterministically normalizes branch, constraint, condition, observation, and check IDs.
builder_materialization.predicate_description: The Builder materializes a missing nullable Predicate description as JSON null and never invents descriptive text.
builder_materialization.component_mapping_refs: The Builder normalizes and verifies each spec_element_ref against the cited branch element and exact Knowledge source_path.
builder_materialization.generation_artifacts: The Builder freezes exact script, Contract, and Rules bytes in an immutable hash-qualified artifact directory and cites those snapshots.
builder_materialization.budget: The Builder assigns all branch shares from a versioned policy; the LLM never allocates budget.

output_constraints: Return only the three response root objects.
Return exactly one decision for every supplied Knowledge record.
Return exactly one component mapping for /learned_hypothesis, every historical anchor, variation opportunity, observation candidate, and limitation in each supplied Knowledge record.

Use represented only when the complete component is cited by one or more exact spec_element_refs; use partially_represented when cited elements preserve only a stated scope; use deferred when no sound representation is emitted.
A represented or partially represented component must have non-empty spec_element_refs. A deferred component must have none. Do not turn free text into an implicit condition.
A decision may be included or deferred; do not reject or rank reviewed Knowledge by subjective importance.
Return exactly one default branch and no generic_exploration branch.
The controlled baseline contains only the default branch and no Knowledge decisions.
Every branch declares input_validity_basis. Use contract_boundary_unresolved with basis_kind unresolved when supplied evidence cannot establish expected-valid or intentionally-invalid status.
expected_valid and intentionally_invalid require a non-unresolved basis. Historical failure or present rejection alone is not sufficient support.
The default branch uses canonical_baseline_definition and cites no Knowledge. Knowledge branches cite the learned hypothesis used by exploration_goal in exploration_goal_source_refs.
A Knowledge-directed branch cites every Knowledge it uses and contains at least one target condition, behavior observation, or behavior check.
Represent historical anchors only as branch constraints or activation_required target conditions; never make them global constraints.
Represent usable variation opportunities as exploration_variable target conditions rather than fixed historical values.
At least one target-API input degree of freedom in every Knowledge branch must remain fuzz-derived; do not reproduce the complete historical input.
An observation candidate may become a record-only behavior observation. Emit a behavior check only when its expected predicate is supported by API/Profile or Knowledge evidence.
Process crash, signal, sanitizer, timeout, hang, and OOM monitoring are fixed Runner responsibilities and must not be repeated as default per-branch checks.
Every Predicate object should include description; use JSON null when no description is supplied.
Use only predicate IDs and exact argument shapes declared by predicate_contracts.
Use exact API Profile parameter_id or return_id values, or context.backend, context.device, context.execution, context.resource, and context.autograd as subject references.
Do not emit risk dimensions, Oracle categories, Strategy Primitives, Helper calls, source code, concrete historical reproducers, or hidden reasoning.
